title: Chat messages between users

requirements.text: Opening a direct conversation with the same user returns one conversation per pair and tenant
Only members can read or send; outsiders and other tenants get not-found
Sends are idempotent on a client id and get a gap-free per-conversation sequence under concurrency
History pages backwards and forwards in order without gaps
Read positions are monotonic and unread counts skip own and deleted messages
A user can block another, preventing direct messages in both directions
New, edited and deleted messages are delivered to online recipients in real time
Message bodies are validated plain text with size limits

evidence.name: openDirect is idempotent: the same pair gets one conversation
SQL: direct conversations are idempotent, including concurrent opens
tenant isolation: outside users cannot use, reach or read another tenant
idempotent on clientId, gap-free seq under concurrency
history pages by beforeSeq and afterSeq in ascending order with hasMore
markRead is monotonic and clamped; unread counts skip own and deleted messages
blocking prevents direct messages in both directions
send: trimmed plain text, idempotent on clientId

implementations.notes: onMessage fan-out hook is tested, but the realtime transport (SSE/WebSocket/pub-sub) is the application's

notes: Building block for realtime-delivery: module:chat emits onMessage events with recipientIds; module:presence shows an SSE stream pattern.
